_readme: Days we are booking each suburb's streets. Add dates as YYYY-MM-DD under the suburb's slug (see service-areas.json / suburbs.ts for slugs). Past dates drop off by themselves. A suburb with no upcoming dates shows the [NEXT DATES] placeholder on its page and a free date picker on the booking form. capacityPerDay is how many bookings one day can take across all suburbs before it shows as booked out.
